Round-trip: Stage 1 → generated text → Stage 2

STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean module RTL: stage1/design.v
InstructionDescribe the interface, parameters, and observable behavior of this clean design. Return a self-contained specification, not RTL implementation code. A separate isolated call will receive your specification.

Stored wording: stage1/TASK.md

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: stage1/design.v · Open raw
module mg_04080(CLK,RST,put,EN_put,RDY_put,get,EN_get,RDY_get,modReady,inverseReady);
parameter DATA_WIDTH = 1; 
  input CLK; 
  input RST; 
  output [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0] get; 
  input [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0] put; 
  input EN_get; 
  input EN_put; 
  output RDY_get; 
  output RDY_put; 
  output modReady; 
  output inverseReady; 
  assign get = put; 
  assign RDY_get = 1; 
  assign RDY_put = 1; 
  assign modReady = EN_get; 
  assign inverseReady = EN_put; 
 endmodule
STAGE 2

Repair the module

InputThe generated Stage 1 text plus buggy mutant rtl: stage2_template/design.v. Required top module: mg_04080.
InstructionRepair the functional fault in design.v using the specification and retained RTL context. Return the complete corrected RTL with the same top module. Only the default configuration is scored.

Stored wording: stage2_template/TASK.md

OutputComplete repaired RTL module.
Read input: stage2_template/design.v · Open raw
module mg_04080(CLK,RST,put,EN_put,RDY_put,get,EN_get,RDY_get,modReady,inverseReady);
parameter DATA_WIDTH = 1; 
  input CLK; 
  input RST; 
  output [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0] get; 
  input [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0] put; 
  input EN_get; 
  input EN_put; 
  output RDY_get; 
  output RDY_put; 
  output modReady; 
  output inverseReady; 
  assign get = put; 
  assign RDY_get = 1; 
  assign RDY_put = 1; 
  assign modReady = ~(EN_get); 
  assign inverseReady = EN_put; 
 endmodule
Stage 1 output → abstraction gate → fresh Stage 2 input. The intermediate text is generated separately for each model/attempt. It is not a prefilled golden description. Stage 2 receives neither the clean RTL nor the Stage 1 conversation.

Private final evaluation

Reference RTLprivate/golden.v
Score / oracleBinary formal equivalence to the hidden clean module

The formal oracle consumes the complete Stage 2 RTL file and compares it with the clean reference. A golden RTL file is scoring material, not a generated Stage 1 output.

entry_point:
Agent entry point — start here

Round-trip tasks have two separate agent entry points:

  1. Stage 1: stage1/TASK.md
  2. Stage 2: stage2_template/TASK.md

Follow the stage panels below for each stage’s input files and required output. The accepted Stage 1 text is supplied to a fresh Stage 2 context; Stage 2 does not receive clean RTL or the Stage 1 conversation.

A stored instruction is distinct from the runtime launch message, which can add framing and execution limits. The agent uses the harness’s file-reading tools to inspect available inputs. The file list also includes human-review reference and oracle assets that must not be given to the evaluated agent.
